title: Closing of our $2M pre-seed round
body_markdown: Announcing the closing of our $2M pre-seed round! We're happy to be supported by[Y Combinator](https://www.linkedin.com/company/y-combinator/) ,[Soma Capital](https://www.linkedin.com/company/somacapital/) ,[Karman Ventures](https://www.linkedin.com/company/karman-vc/) ,[Kulveer Taggar](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kulveer/) ,[Leonis Investissement](https://www.linkedin.com/company/leonis-vc/) , as well as participation by awesome founders, funds and angels like[Nate Matherson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/natematherson/) ,[Jude Gomila](https://www.linkedin.com/in/judegomila/) ,[Jeff Heitzman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffheitzman/) ,[Niraj Shah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nashah/) , Eli B.,[Benjamin Bryant](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhbryant/) ,[Ajira Ventures](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ajira-ventures/) and more.
